stock.description: BeijingWest Industries International Limited serves as an investment holding entity, specializing in the design, manufacturing, sale, and distribution of automotive components and parts across diverse international markets. Its operational footprint includes Mainland China, the United Kingdom, Germany, and the United States, among other regions globally. The company's primary offerings comprise advanced automotive suspension systems, specifically engineered for use in high-end passenger automobiles. Additionally, it provides vital research and development alongside technical support services. Headquartered in Wanchai, Hong Kong, the firm adopted its current name, BeijingWest Industries International Limited, in January 2014, having previously been known as Norstar Founders Group Limited. It functions as a subsidiary of BWI Company Limited.
